lessons.title: Week 39 Part 1: Strengthening Daily Caregiving & Home Safety
lessons.content: In Week 39 of Keeping Families Together Preservation Practice, this lesson focuses on strengthening daily caregiving & home safety. Parents and carers practise pausing to notice stress cues, responding with calm and predictable language, maintaining child-safe boundaries, and recording one observable example of how this skill supported their child's safety and emotional wellbeing this week.
